skill.name: claude-opus-4-5-migration
skill.description: Migrate prompts and code from Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, or Opus 4.1 to Opus 4.5. Use when the user wants to update their codebase, prompts, or API calls to use Opus 4.5. Handles model string updates and prompt adjustments for known Opus 4.5 behavioral differences. Does NOT migrate Haiku 4.5.
skill.summary: Update supported Claude applications, provider model identifiers, and prompts for Opus 4.5.
skill.author: anthropics

content.value_statement: Updating model identifiers and prompts across providers can be inconsistent. This skill guides targeted Opus 4.5 migrations with provider settings and prompt adjustments.
actual_capabilities: Searches projects for supported Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 model identifiers.
Selects the documented Opus 4.5 identifier for Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or Azure AI Foundry.
Removes the unsupported one-million-token context beta header and adds an explanatory comment.
Provides high-effort configuration guidance and the required beta flag.
Adjusts prompts for reported tool overuse, excess complexity, limited code exploration, generic frontend design, or thinking sensitivity.
Summarizes model, header, effort, and prompt changes after migration.
limitations: Only Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 are supported as source models.
Haiku models are explicitly excluded from migration.
Prompt adjustments require an explicit request or a reported behavior issue.
The guide uses dated model identifiers and beta headers, so current provider support needs separate verification.

use_cases.title: Upgrade an Anthropic Application
use_cases.description: Update eligible model calls, remove an incompatible context header, and review effort settings in an existing application.
use_cases.target_user: Backend developers using the Anthropic API

use_cases.title: Update Managed Cloud Models
use_cases.description: Apply the documented Opus 4.5 identifier for Bedrock, Vertex AI, or Azure AI Foundry.

use_cases.title: Tune Migrated Prompts
use_cases.description: Address specific Opus 4.5 behavior changes while preserving the existing prompt structure and functional content.
use_cases.target_user: Prompt engineers and AI product teams

prompt_templates.title: Basic Model Upgrade
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate [project path] from [supported source model] to Opus 4.5. Update only model identifiers and summarize the changed files.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a focused model identifier update.

prompt_templates.title: Provider-Specific Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate [project path] to Opus 4.5 on [provider]. Review model identifiers, unsupported headers, and effort configuration, then summarize each change.
prompt_templates.scenario: An application uses a specific API or managed cloud provider.

prompt_templates.title: Prompt Behavior Adjustment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [prompt file] for Opus 4.5 after [reported issue]. Apply only relevant prompt adjustments and explain every modification.
prompt_templates.scenario: A migrated prompt shows a known behavior difference.

prompt_templates.title: Complete Migration Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a complete Opus 4.5 migration for [project]. Detect the provider, update eligible models, review headers and effort settings, assess reported prompt issues, and summarize changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a complete, provider-aware migration review.

output_examples.input: Migrate an Anthropic API project from Sonnet 4.5 and review its context header.
output: Updated eligible Sonnet 4.5 references to the documented Opus 4.5 model.
Removed the unsupported one-million-token context beta header and added a compatibility note.
Listed every changed file and setting.

output_examples.input: The migrated assistant calls tools too often.
output: Reviewed tool-triggering instructions for aggressive emphasis.
Softened only the relevant mandatory wording while preserving other prompt requirements.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Bedrock migration and include effort guidance.
output: Selected the documented Bedrock target identifier for Opus 4.5.
Reviewed high-effort configuration and its required beta flag.
Flagged provider support for verification before deployment.

best_practices: Confirm the active provider before replacing model identifiers.
Apply prompt snippets only for an explicit request or a reproduced behavior issue.
Review the final diff and verify current model availability before deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not migrate Haiku model references with this skill.
Do not append every prompt snippet without matching a reported issue.
Do not assume dated model identifiers or beta flags remain current without provider verification.

faq.question: Which source models can this skill migrate?
faq.answer: It supports Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 as migration sources.

faq.question: Does it migrate Claude Haiku models?
faq.answer: No. Haiku models are explicitly excluded.

faq.question: Which providers are covered?
faq.answer: Target identifiers cover Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry. Source mappings cover Anthropic, Bedrock, and Vertex AI.

faq.question: Will it change prompts automatically?
faq.answer: The default migration changes model identifiers. Prompt adjustments are applied only when requested or when a specific behavior issue is reported.

faq.question: How does it handle the effort setting?
faq.answer: It documents high effort as the migration default and provides the related beta flag. Lower effort levels remain available for cost or latency needs.

faq.question: Does the skill verify current provider availability?
faq.answer: No. The guide contains dated identifiers and beta settings, so teams should verify current provider documentation before deployment.
